hooks.command: prompt=$(jq -r '.prompt // empty' 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; printf '%s' "$prompt" | grep -qiE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(implement|implementation|review|ship|fix|work on|issue|pull request|pr)([^[:alnum:]_]|$)|github\.com/[^[:space:]]+/(issues|pull)/' && printf '%s\n' 'Brock: route this request through the shared router.' || true
